header.notes: Order columns: msb, lsb (fixed), sift_msb / sift_lsb = one budgeted Rudell sifting pass started from msb / lsb. Sifting budget = 2*n^2 adjacent swaps (stops starting new variables once exhausted; 1.2x max growth abort per direction). No random-order fallback used. Each ROBDD verified: DAG satisfying count == |X|, every input element accepted, live nodes == reachable nodes, and full enumeration == input for |X| <= 2^20. X2 raw events = non-infinity values of x(P1+P2), x(P1-P2) over i<=j in F (F is sign-symmetric, so many events coincide by symmetry); collisions = raw - |X2|.
